authorization: User: etymologise all Indo-Aryan SIL surveys jointly; do everything; surface tough/unclear cases for audit once done.

proposals.evidence: CDIAL 11348 *varta gives Gawri wāṭ, Kalasha bat and northern baṭ/baṭh stone. The b/v forms fit this family; initial g requires a distinct stone-word comparison. Reviewed comparison: Kal bāt “stone” (f_z75ulkljjiu24). Possible intra-IA transfer remains open; source forms and provenance are preserved.
